name: ecko-ai-commercial-lab
description: AI-native commercial production lab: GPT-directed storyboards, generated visual assets, code-driven motion, and reproducible MP4 rendering.

scripts.prepare:aurora: npm run audio:aurora && npm run assets:aurora && npm run validate && node scripts/validate.mjs --prepared
scripts.render:aurora: npm run prepare:aurora && remotion render src/index.ts AuroraColdBrew artifacts/astra-001/aurora-astra-master.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --image-format=png --color-space=bt709 --pixel-format=yuv420p --concurrency=4 --log=error && node scripts/finalize_astra.mjs
scripts.preview:aurora: npm run prepare:aurora && remotion render src/index.ts AuroraColdBrew artifacts/astra-001/preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --image-format=png --color-space=bt709 --pixel-format=yuv420p --scale=0.5 --concurrency=4 --log=error
